# Vendored surf-cli copy

This tree is synced into `agent-skills/skills/surf/vendor/surf-cli` by
`surf vendor.sync`. Do not edit only here during active fork development —
change `experiments/surf-cli` (or the GitHub fork), then sync.

```bash
surf vendor.sync --from ~/workspace/experiments/surf-cli --build --reload
# or
surf vendor.sync --git --ref main --build --reload
```

See `../fork.json` and `../README.md`.
